race.comment: BACK TO BONDI (2) missed in a narrow defeat two back here before leading at Pinjarra last week. On the quick turnaround here and the rise in trip shouldn't be an issue. Maps to get every chance under Nottle and he can get the job done dropping back in class. SOLO VEGA (5) is third-up now following  a 2.4L defeat last time out. The fresh run was superb and things look to set up nicely for her third-up into the campaign. Should be at her peak now and a forward showing is on the cards. GRANDAD'S ADICTION (8) finished 2L off the winner at Pinjarra last time out and the inside barrier is a big tick for his chances. On the quick turnaround again, for CJP and he can get the job done. PURE MAC (1) missed first-up but should be better for that effort. Won't be far away. POINT GIBRALTAR (3) bolted in as a $21 chance last start and steps out to the mile for the first time now. Can repeat the dose.
